title: geoparquet-validator report
description: What `geoparquet-validator check --json`, the library functions and the browser build return for one file. report_version is bumped when a field changes meaning or goes away; fields may be added without a bump.

file.description: the path or URL that was checked

version.description: the GeoParquet version the file declares, or "unknown"

rules.description: which rules were applied, in words

sampled.description: true when only the first row groups were read; the data tests are then a sample, not a conformance pass

traffic.description: [bytes fetched, range requests] for a remote source, null for a local file

outcomes.description: one entry per abstract test, always all 28, in document order

advice.description: the distribution best practices measured on the file; never a conformance verdict
